one_line: CodeElo exposes recent Codeforces problems submitted to official judge as an auditable evaluation surface.
CodeElo 把提交至官方评测机的近期 Codeforces 题目做成可审计的评测面。
why: Official platform judging plus recent tasks are strong leakage controls.

title: Problem
问题
html: Primary sources: arXiv:2501.01257, the CodeElo project page, QwenLM/CodeElo, and the Qwen/CodeElo dataset page linked by the repository. The problem is that many contest-code benchmarks lack private tests, special-judge support, and environment alignment. CodeElo is in scope as a competition-level coding evaluation surface, not as a training recipe. A task is a recent Codeforces contest problem with title, limits, statement, examples, optional notes, contest division, difficulty rating, tags, and an official-platform submission result.

一手来源包括 arXiv:2501.01257、CodeElo 项目页、QwenLM/CodeElo 仓库，以及仓库链接的 Qwen/CodeElo 数据页。它解决的问题是许多竞赛代码基准缺少私有测试、special judge 支持和执行环境对齐。CodeElo 的收录边界是 competition-level coding evaluation surface，不是训练 recipe。一个任务是近期 Codeforces 题，包含标题、时限/内存、题面、样例、可选 note、竞赛 division、难度 rating、标签和官方平台提交结果。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The contribution is a standardized Codeforces-based benchmark that submits model solutions to the official platform and converts contest performance into human-comparable Elo ratings. The core mechanism avoids reimplementing hidden tests or special judges: the platform judge supplies accepted/rejected feedback. Closest comparisons are LiveCodeBench, USACO-style benchmarks, APPS, CodeContests, and AlphaCode's Codeforces simulation. The feedback contract is Codeforces judgment plus the authors' Elo calculation; the direction label is live hidden-contamination-resistant evaluation with an external judge.

核心贡献是一个基于 Codeforces 的标准化基准：模型解答直接提交到官方平台，再把竞赛表现换算为可与人类比较的 Elo。机制避免重建 hidden tests 或 special judges，由平台 judge 给 accepted/rejected 反馈。最接近的参照是 LiveCodeBench、USACO 类基准、APPS、CodeContests 和 AlphaCode 的 Codeforces 模拟。反馈契约是 Codeforces 判定加作者的 Elo 计算；方向标签是带外部 judge 的 live/抗污染评测。

title: Method
方法
html: 1. Inputs: recent six-month Codeforces contest problems with divisions, ratings, tags, and problem text. 2. Generation: evaluate 30 open-source and 3 proprietary LLMs under specified decoding/API settings; open-source defaults include temperature 0.7, top_p 0.8, top_k 20, and repetition_penalty 1.1. 3. Submission: submit solutions to Codeforces, capped at eight submissions per problem. 4. Output: official verdicts, pass statistics, and Elo estimates. 5. Reproducibility: pin contest IDs, date, language, model settings, submission API/token policy, Codeforces terms, and leaderboard date.

1. 输入：近 6 个月 Codeforces 竞赛题，含 division、rating、tag 和题面。2. 生成：评测 30 个开源模型和 3 个闭源模型；开源默认设置包括 temperature 0.7、top_p 0.8、top_k 20、repetition_penalty 1.1。3. 提交：把解答提交到 Codeforces，每题最多 8 次。4. 输出：官方 verdict、通过统计和 Elo 估计。5. 复现：固定 contest IDs、日期、语言、模型设置、提交 API/token 策略、Codeforces 条款和 leaderboard 日期。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper reports Elo ratings for 33 models; o1-mini and QwQ-32B-Preview are highlighted at 1578 and 1261, and many models remain in the lowest human-performance band. The paper also reports that testing across 54 contests reduces overall rating standard deviation to about 50. Instance-level evidence is the Codeforces verdict returned by the official platform, including cases that need hidden tests or special judges. Evidence is bounded by virtual participation rules, eight-submission cap, contest set, language choice, and platform availability.

论文报告了 33 个模型的 Elo；其中 o1-mini 和 QwQ-32B-Preview 分别为 1578 和 1261，许多模型仍处在人类表现低位区间。论文还报告跨 54 场竞赛测试后总体平均 rating 的标准差约降到 50。样本级证据是 Codeforces 官方平台返回的 verdict，包括需要 hidden tests 或 special judge 的题。证据边界包括 virtual participation 规则、每题 8 次提交上限、竞赛集合、语言选择和平台可用性。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior benchmarks often provided offline tests or public examples; CodeElo changes the verifier to the live official Codeforces judge and maps outcomes to human-comparable Elo. The direction signal is external-platform evaluation for difficult code reasoning with hidden tests, special judges, and aligned runtimes. Quality signals include recent contest selection, metadata by division/rating/tag, public code for Elo/ranking logic, and a project leaderboard. What is not new: Codeforces problems and Elo ratings. Reuse checks: platform permission, submission throttling, token access, contest updates, license, and contamination.

已有基准多提供离线测试或公开样例；CodeElo 把 verifier 改成 live 的 Codeforces 官方 judge，并把结果映射到可与人类比较的 Elo。方向信号是面向困难代码推理的外部平台评测，覆盖 hidden tests、special judges 和对齐运行时。质量信号包括近期竞赛选择、division/rating/tag 元数据、公开 Elo/ranking 逻辑和项目 leaderboard。并不新的部分是 Codeforces 题和 Elo。复用要查平台许可、提交限流、token 访问、竞赛更新、许可证和污染。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Correctness is delegated to Codeforces; the benchmark does not disclose hidden tests or special judges and cannot be fully reproduced offline without platform interaction. The eight-submission cap may understate capability for systems that would solve with more attempts, but reduces platform impact. CodeElo is for academic virtual participation, not in-contest use. Scores can drift with Codeforces policy, availability, contest set, language, model decoding, API defaults, and access to the authors' automated submission service. Dataset license details remain an audit target.

正确性委托给 Codeforces；基准不公开 hidden tests 或 special judges，因此没有平台交互就不能完整离线复现。每题 8 次提交上限可能低估更多尝试能解出的系统，但可降低对平台的影响。CodeElo 只适合学术 virtual participation，不适合赛中使用。分数会随 Codeforces 政策、可用性、竞赛集合、语言、模型解码、API 默认值和作者自动提交服务访问而漂移。数据许可证仍需单独审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use CodeElo as a design reference for live external-judge benchmarks. Preserve contest id, problem id, division, rating, tags, language, prompt, model decoding, submission count, verdict, timestamp, and Elo calculation version. It is valuable for leakage-aware coding evaluation because recent official-platform problems reduce reliance on replicated hidden tests. It should not be converted into a training reward stream without platform-policy review and strict rate, provenance, and contamination controls.

CodeElo 可作为 live external-judge benchmark 的设计参考。应保留 contest id、problem id、division、rating、tag、语言、prompt、模型解码、提交次数、verdict、时间戳和 Elo 计算版本。它对抗污染代码评测有价值，因为近期官方平台题减少了对复制 hidden tests 的依赖。若要转成训练 reward 流，必须先审查平台政策，并严格控制提交频率、来源和污染。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Separate three things: official Codeforces verdicts, the authors' Elo conversion, and public dataset/problem metadata. CodeElo's strength is external judging, but that also makes reproducibility depend on a third-party platform. Read limitations and ethical statement before using the GitHub scaffold; the repository requires verified access to its automated submission service, and users may need to implement their own submission interface.
要分开三件事：Codeforces 官方 verdict、作者的 Elo 换算、公开的数据/题目元数据。CodeElo 的强点是外部 judge，但这也让复现依赖第三方平台。使用 GitHub scaffold 前先读 limitations 和 ethical statement；仓库说明自动提交服务需要验证访问，用户也可能要实现自己的提交接口。
